allow: Read-only GitHub CLI inspection in this repository: gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr checks, gh pr diff, gh run list, gh run view, gh run watch, and gh api GET requests. These only read state.
Opening pull requests with gh pr create against any base branch in this repository. A PR is a proposal, not a deployment, and it is the required mechanism here.

Merging a pull request with gh pr merge --squash or --merge when GitHub's own required checks have passed. This repository's promotion policy is enforced in CI by the guard-main-source and verify jobs and by the release-test workflow, so a merge GitHub accepts on passing checks is one the policy already permits. This includes the test -> main promotion PR.
soft_deny: Passing --admin to gh pr merge, or any other flag or API call that merges past failing or still-pending required checks. The guard-main-source job and the release-test build gate are the only enforcement of this repository's promotion path; overriding them ships unvalidated code to main.

Merging any pull request whose checks have not yet reported. A freshly opened PR reports no checks for several seconds, and treating that as success has already caused an unvalidated merge to main. Wait for checks to appear and pass.
Pushing directly to main or test, force-pushing any shared branch, and deleting remote branches other than feature branches whose PR has merged.
